snippet.description:
Gina is set to take over as the new ruler of the Kingdom of Triss following her father’s death..But her brother Morgan has other plans. Determined to stop her, Morgan enlists the help of the demon Lala to cast a hypnotic curse on his sister, hoping she relinquishes the crown to him. However…
